import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RegularDifferentialModule
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4DivisorModule

/-!
# Canonical divisor modules and regular differential modules

Multiplication by a specified nonzero rational differential identifies the
module of its divisor with the intrinsic regular differential module.  The
isomorphism depends on the specified differential.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom] [IsProper X.hom]

/-- Multiplication by a rational differential commutes with the regular
function action on its divisor sections. -/
lemma divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_action
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U))
    (s : divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U) :
    divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U
        (divisorSectionAction (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U r s) =
      regularDifferentialSectionAction U r
        (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U s) := by
  classical
  by_cases hU : (U : Set X.left).Nonempty
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe,
      divisorSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty _ U hU,
      regularDifferentialSectionAction_coe_of_nonempty U hU,
      divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_coe, mul_smul]
  · letI := regularDifferentialSections_subsingleton_of_empty X hU
    exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

/-- Multiplication by a specified nonzero rational differential as a morphism
from its divisor module to the intrinsic regular differential module. -/
noncomputable def canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ⟶
      regularDifferentialModule (X := X) where
  val := by
    letI sourceInstances : ∀ W,
        Module (X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj W)
          ((divisorAbPresheaf (differentialDivisor X ω hω)).obj W) :=
      fun W => divisorSectionsModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω) W.unop
    letI targetInstances : ∀ W,
        Module (X.left.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj W)
          ((regularDifferentialAbPresheaf (X := X)).obj W) :=
      fun W => regularDifferentialSectionsModule W.unop
    exact
      { app := fun U => ModuleCat.ofHom
          { toFun := divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U.unop
            map_add' := map_add _
            map_smul' := fun r s =>
              divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_action X ω hω U.unop r s }
        naturality := fun {U V} i => by
          ext s
          exact DFunLike.congr_fun
            (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
              ((regularDifferentialPresheafIso X ω hω).hom.naturality i)) s }

@[simp]
lemma canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule_app_apply
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (s : Γ(divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω), U)) :
    (canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule X ω hω).app U s =
      divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U s := rfl

lemma canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule_isIso
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    IsIso (canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule X ω hω) := by
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro U
  rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
  change Function.Bijective (divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials X ω hω U)
  exact ⟨divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_injective X ω hω U,
    divisorSectionsToRegularDifferentials_surjective X ω hω U⟩

/-- The `O_X`-module isomorphism induced by a selected nonzero rational
differential; the target is intrinsic but the isomorphism depends on the choice. -/
noncomputable def canonicalDivisorModuleIsoRegularDifferentialModule
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0) :
    divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω) ≅
      regularDifferentialModule (X := X) := by
  letI := canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule_isIso X ω hω
  exact asIso (canonicalDivisorToRegularDifferentialModule X ω hω)

@[simp]
lemma canonicalDivisorModuleIsoRegularDifferentialModule_hom_app_coe
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) (hω : ω ≠ 0)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (s : Γ(divisorModule (differentialDivisor X ω hω), U)) :
    Subtype.val (show regularDifferentialSections X U from
      (canonicalDivisorModuleIsoRegularDifferentialModule X ω hω).hom.app U s) =
        ((show divisorSections (differentialDivisor X ω hω) U from s) :
          X.left.functionField) • ω := rfl

end
end Hartshorne
